title: Russell US Style indexes — conditional quarter-end capping check effective at the open of 2027-09-30 (24% / 4.8%-above-48% test struck on the 2027-09-27 close), the missing link between the tracked June and December 2027 instances
source: EST: rule-derived by applying the family's OWN published rule — re-extracted first-hand by this proposer, not inherited — to the September 2027 session calendar. THE RULE: FTSE Russell, "Capping Methodology Guide", v5.4, September 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, capping-methodology-guide.pdf, HTTP 200, 652,008 bytes, 62 content streams inflated and text-extracted in-session 2026-09-09 — the identical counts four siblings recorded), section 4.8.6: every Russell US Style row reads price date "T-3", effective date "Last business day of each month", trigger "No company is greater than 24%, and all companies that have a weight greater than 4.8% in aggregate are no more than 48% of the index", scheme "Rule 4.2/RIC 22.5/45". THE ARITHMETIC: the last business day of September 2027 is Thursday 2027-09-30 and September 2027 carries no NYSE closure after Labor Day (Monday 2027-09-06) — read from nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct by this proposer 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes), and corroborated by this repo's own src/domain/market-calendar.ts — so T-3 counts back 09-29, 09-28, 09-27 to Monday 2027-09-27, with no holiday step. THE DERIVATION WAS TESTED, NOT ASSERTED: the same trading-day rule reproduces all four of the owner's published 2026 quarter-end cut-offs to the day (26 March, 25 June, 25 September, 28 December), read at the column level this session from the July 2026 FAQ (ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 198,134 bytes, 19 streams). September is a quarter-end under BOTH readings of the owner's disputed frequency wording, so this instance needs no position on that conflict. Filed estimate on the four counts this family always records: a proposal is estimate by contract, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, the confirmed-tier prefixes in market-events-data.ts have no member for an index owner's own published methodology, and the FAQ's schedule table carries "NOTE: Dates may be subject to change." Conditional by construction — the FAQ says "If no breach is identified, no changes are made." Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-12-31 initial research (2026-09-09). THE GAP IS EXACT AND WAS NAMED BEFORE IT WAS FILLED: this calendar tracks russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective- for 2026-09-30, 2026-12-31, 2027-03-31, 2027-06-30 and now 2027-12-31, and the September 2027 instance is the one hole in that run. The proposal that created the proposer's own id said so explicitly and declined to file it — "The 2027-09-30 instance is the same gap, sits outside this proposer's corridor, and is deliberately NOT filed here." It is filed now because the proposer re-derived the identical rule from the identical primaries this session to date its own instance, so the September date costs nothing extra and the run is contiguous rather than carrying an unexplained hole a later lane would re-discover. IT IS ALSO THE PROPOSER'S OWN CONTROL. The proposer's headline is that December 2027's cut-off-to-test drift window is 18 trading sessions, the longest this family has measured; that claim is only legible against the other quarters of the same year. Under the same derivation September 2027 reads style capping cut-off Wednesday 2027-09-08 (the Monday after September's third-Friday implementation, 2027-09-20, minus 12 calendar days) and a test struck on the 2027-09-27 close, a 13-session window, which the proposer measured at 54 of 1,241 rolling windows = 4.35% against December's 105 of 1,236 = 8.50% on the same 1,254-bar set. THE REVIEW DATES ARE THE LESS CERTAIN HALF AND ARE FLAGGED AS SUCH: the Monday-after-the-implementation-Friday rule reproduces all four published 2026 columns and every cut-off it produces is a Wednesday exactly as all four published ones are, but no owner document published as of this session carries a 2027 column, and September's implementation Friday is the QUARTERLY IPO REVIEW's third Friday rather than a reconstitution — a class this calendar tracks separately as russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-. The quarter-end pair (09-27 test, 09-30 effective) rests on the T-3 rule alone and is the firmer of the two. A taking lane should re-fetch the FTSE Russell FAQ and settle the review dates from the owner's own 2027 column if one has been published by then. Impact low and symbols deliberately EMPTY on this family's standing measured grounds, re-verified by the proposer this session: no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped for rebalanc|reconstitution|russell|capping|index.flow|IWF|IWY -> zero hits in both), a fired recap moves roughly $475M across five of the most liquid names on the tape, and an ETF proxy in symbols would make the deterministic screen trip on mega-cap beta. Conditional and historically it usually does not fire; the proposer makes no claim that it will in September 2027 and no weight measured in 2026 forecasts a 2027 breach. Nothing here licenses an entry.
